title: Psalms 69
paragraphs: ¹ Save me, O God, for the waters have come up to my neck. ² I sink in deep mud where there is no foothold; I have come into the deep waters, and the flood sweeps over me. ³ I am weary with my crying; my throat is dry. My eyes grow dim with waiting for my God. ⁴ Those who hate me without cause outnumber the hairs of my head; many are my enemies without reason — those who seek to destroy me. I am forced to restore what I did not steal. ⁵ O God, you know my foolishness; my guilt is not hidden from you.

⁶ Let not those who hope in you be put to shame through me, O Lord GOD of hosts; let not those who seek you be brought to disgrace through me, O God of Israel. ⁷ For it is for your sake that I have borne reproach; shame has covered my face. ⁸ I have become a stranger to my brothers, an outsider to my mother's children. ⁹ Zeal for your house has consumed me; the insults of those who insult you have fallen on me. ¹⁰ When I wept and fasted, it turned to my reproach.

¹¹ When I put on sackcloth, I became a byword to them. ¹² Those who sit at the gate mock me, and the drunkards make up songs about me. ¹³ But I pray to you, O LORD, at an acceptable time. O God, in the abundance of your steadfast love, answer me in your saving faithfulness. ¹⁴ Deliver me from sinking in the mire; let me be rescued from my enemies and from the deep waters. ¹⁵ Let not the flood sweep over me, or the deep swallow me, or the pit close its mouth over me.

¹⁶ Answer me, O LORD, for your steadfast love is good; according to your abundant mercy, turn to me. ¹⁷ Do not hide your face from your servant — I am in distress; answer me quickly. ¹⁸ Draw near to me; redeem me; ransom me because of my enemies. ¹⁹ You know my reproach, my shame, and my dishonor; all my enemies are before you. ²⁰ Reproach has broken my heart, and I am in despair. I looked for sympathy, but there was none — for comforters, but I found no one.

²¹ They gave me poison for food, and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink. ²² Let their own table become a snare for them, and when they are at peace, let it be a trap. ²³ Let their eyes grow dark so they cannot see, and make their bodies shake continually. ²⁴ Pour out your indignation on them; let your burning anger overtake them. ²⁵ May their camp be left desolate; may no one dwell in their tents.

²⁶ For they persecute those you have struck down; they heap on the pain of those you have wounded. ²⁷ Charge them with guilt upon guilt; do not let them share in your righteousness. ²⁸ Let them be blotted out of the book of life and not be listed with the righteous. ²⁹ But I am afflicted and in pain; let your salvation, O God, set me on high. ³⁰ I will praise the name of God with a song; I will magnify him with thanksgiving.

³¹ This will please the LORD more than an ox or a bull with horns and hoofs. ³² When the humble see this, they will be glad; you who seek God, let your hearts revive. ³³ For the LORD hears the needy and does not despise his own who are captives. ³⁴ Let heaven and earth praise him, the seas and everything that moves in them. ³⁵ For God will save Zion and rebuild the cities of Judah; his people will settle there and possess it.
³⁶ The children of his servants will inherit it, and those who love his name will dwell in it.
